work.title: Untitled (Studio Wall View)
work.description: Studio photograph showing a large mixed-media mural mounted on a wall, secured with blue painter's tape along its lower edge. Concentric target rings, spiral motifs, tree-like vertical forms, and figurative elements populate the densely layered composition; a metal worktable in the foreground reflects the mural below.
work.composition: wide mural filling wall behind worktable
